description: This file defines kernel package configurations for specific hardware support modules, such as Marvell SATA and SDIO drivers, for the OpenWrt Linux build system. It specifies dependencies, configuration options, associated kernel object files, and descriptions.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ata-marvell-sata
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Marvell SATA support with its dependencies and properties.

methods.name: KernelPackage/mvsdio
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Marvell SDIO host driver with associated properties.
